description: Preview, edit and export Markdown to PDF and RTF.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Raw HTML and custom stylesheets are disabled in untrusted workspaces.
config.preview.theme.auto: Follow the VS Code color theme.
config.preview.customCss: Stylesheets added to the preview. Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder.
config.preview.scrollSync: Synchronize scrolling between the editor and the preview.
config.markdown.allowHtml: Render raw HTML in Markdown (sanitized). Ignored in untrusted workspaces.
config.export.outputDir: Folder for exported files. Supports `${fileDirname}` and `${workspaceFolder}`; relative paths resolve against the Markdown file.
config.export.askLocation: Ask where to save each export instead of using the output folder.
config.export.pageSize: Page size for PDF and RTF exports.
config.export.landscape: Use landscape orientation for PDF and RTF exports.
config.export.margin: Page margins as a CSS length or shorthand, e.g. `20mm` or `15mm 20mm`.
config.pdf.executablePath: Path to Chrome, Edge or Chromium used to print PDFs. Leave empty to detect automatically.
config.pdf.headerTemplate: HTML for the PDF page header. Use `<span class="title">`, `<span class="date">`, `<span class="pageNumber">` and `<span class="totalPages">`. Empty for no header.
config.pdf.footerTemplate: HTML for the PDF page footer (same placeholders as the header). Empty for no footer.
config.rtf.codeFontFamily: Monospace font for code in RTF exports.
config.rtf.fontSize: Body font size in points for RTF exports.
